description: Read one archived run with its receipt: the stored document (or its disclosure document after a redaction, or nothing once the body aged out), the chain position, the signature, the install's public key, the redacted paths, and the verify URL. The receipt names its canonicalization (RFC 8785) so verify_receipt can check it offline. A member of the install's endpoint reads it; a stranger gets 404.
name: get_locker_run
title: Get locker run
